basic_details.job_title: Bihar Vidhan Sabha Office Attendant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Matric pass candidates can apply for 5 posts of Office Attendant (Karyalaya Parichari) in Bihar Vidhan Sabha Sachivalaya (Bihar Legislative Assembly Secretariat), Patna, on Pay Level-1 (Rs. 18,000-56,900 plus other admissible allowances as per rules), under Advertisement No. 02/2026. Applications are accepted only online, from 7 November 2026 (from 11:00 AM) to 6 December 2026. The fee must also be paid by 6 December 2026. Selection is by an interview of 100 marks, with a preliminary OMR test if applications exceed 40,000.

application_fee.details: The fee is paid online by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card while applying, by 6 December 2026. Bank charges are payable on top of the fee. The fee will not be refunded. SC or ST candidates who pay the SC/ST fee and later cannot produce the certificate, or whose certificate is doubted, may be declared ineligible; such candidates may choose to pay the general fee to keep their candidature safe.

age_limit.details: The minimum age is 18 years. Age will be counted from the date of birth recorded in the Matric or equivalent examination certificate. | Category Maximum Age General (Unreserved) men 37 years General (Unreserved) women, Backward Class and Extremely Backward Class (men and women) 40 years Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe (men and women) 42 years

how_to_apply: Use the "Apply Online" link given in the notice to register and fill the online application between 7 November 2026 (from 11:00 AM) and 6 December 2026.
Enter your own working mobile number and email ID, and keep the email ID, mobile number, User Name and Password safe until the final result.
Upload scans of your educational qualification certificate, reservation-related certificates, a recent photograph and your signature, and make sure the images are clear.
Pay the examination fee online by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card, and print and keep the bank receipt.
After final submission, log in again and download the filled application from "Download Filled Application Section" on the dashboard; print two copies.
Check that the Bar Code and Application Number appear on every page of the printout; without either, the application is treated as incomplete and will not be accepted.

Detailed instructions for the online application are on the Sabha Sachivalaya website, https://vidhansabha.bihar.gov.in/. Printed, typed or handwritten applications outside the online form will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice gives 5 provisional vacancies for Office Attendant, divided by reservation category. Of these, 3 posts are for women under 35% horizontal reservation. The notice states that the number of advertised posts may decrease or increase. Reservation is given only to candidates whose permanent residence is in Bihar. Residents of other states do not get reservation benefit. Reservation must be claimed in the marked column of the online form; the permanent address filled in the online form is taken for reservation purposes. SC and ST candidates claiming reservation must have a caste certificate and a permanent residence (domicile) certificate. For unmarried or married women, the caste certificate must be issued from the father's permanent address. BC and EBC candidates claiming reservation must have a caste certificate, a permanent residence certificate and a non-creamy layer certificate (women: issued from the father's permanent address). EWS gets 10% reservation as per rules when a vacancy is available; the income and asset certificate must be in Annexure-1 (Form-1) of the General Administration Department notification No. 2622 dated 26.02.2019. Women get 35% horizontal reservation as per rules when a vacancy is available. The reservation category cannot be changed while the appointment process is under way.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Nationality: The candidate must be a citizen of India. Educational qualification: By the last date of online application, the candidate must have passed Matric or equivalent from a board recognised by the State Government or the Central Government. The minimum age is 18 years. Age will be counted from the date of birth recorded in the Matric or equivalent examination certificate. Each relaxation requires a certificate from the competent authority. For disability, the certificate must be valid up to the last date of application. For the discipline and post-wise details, candidates should check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Office Attendant
content_sections.text: Use the "Apply Online" link given in the notice to register and fill the online application between 7 November 2026 (from 11:00 AM) and 6 December 2026. Enter your own working mobile number and email ID, and keep the email ID, mobile number, User Name and Password safe until the final result. Upload scans of your educational qualification certificate, reservation-related certificates, a recent photograph and your signature, and make sure the images are clear. Pay the examination fee online by Net Banking, Credit Card or Debit Card, and print and keep the bank receipt. After final submission, log in again and download the filled application from "Download Filled Application Section" on the dashboard; print two copies. Check that the Bar Code and Application Number appear on every page of the printout; without either, the application is treated as incomplete and will not be accepted. Detailed instructions for the online application are on the Sabha Sachivalaya website, https://vidhansabha.bihar.gov.in/ . Printed, typed or handwritten applications outside the online form will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Candidates for the Office Attendant post will be interviewed. The interview carries 100 marks, and the merit list will be prepared on interview marks. If applications exceed 40,000, a preliminary examination (OMR answer-sheet based, objective multiple choice) may be held. In that case, about 10 times the number of vacancies, from among candidates who obtain the fixed qualifying marks, will be selected for the interview. Candidates who do not reach these marks will be out of the competition. Equal marks: the older candidate is placed higher. Equal marks and same date of birth: the candidate with the higher educational qualification is placed higher. Still equal: the order follows the Devanagari alphabetical order of the name as written in the Class 10 board certificate. Information on the examination or interview programme will be published on the Bihar Vidhan Sabha website.

faq.question: Q1. How many Office Attendant vacancies are there in Bihar Vidhan Sabha Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 provisional vacancies: 1 Unreserved, 1 ST, 1 EBC and 2 BC, of which 3 are for women. The number may decrease or increase.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Office Attendant?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application and for fee payment is 6 December 2026. Applications open on 7 November 2026 from 11:00 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Office Attendant?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed Matric or equivalent from a board recognised by the State or Central Government by the last date of online application.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Office Attendant?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years. The maximum is 37 years for General men, 40 years for General women, BC and EBC, and 42 years for SC and ST.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Bihar Vidhan Sabha Office Attendant?
faq.answer: The post is on Pay Level-1, Rs. 18,000-56,900, plus other admissible allowances as per rules.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 400 for EBC, BC, EWS and Unreserved men of Bihar and all candidates from outside Bihar, and Rs. 100 for SC, ST, 40% or more disabled candidates and all women who are native residents of Bihar.

faq.question: Q7. How is the selection made?
faq.answer: Selection is by an interview of 100 marks, and the merit list is made on interview marks. If applications exceed 40,000, a preliminary OMR objective test may be held first.

faq.question: Q8. What are the qualifying marks in the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates need 40% (General), 36.5% (BC), 34% (EBC) or 32% (SC/ST, women and persons with disabilities) in the interview, or they will be out of the competition.

faq.question: Q9. Do candidates from outside Bihar get reservation?
faq.answer: No. Reservation is given only to candidates whose permanent residence is in Bihar; residents of other states do not get reservation and pay the Rs. 400 fee.
